summary: Read several integers that all differ from one another. Write every subset of that list. A subset keeps some of the values, and it may keep none of them or keep all of them. Inside a subset, the left-to-right order of values matches their order in the input. Do not emit one subset two times. Any integer may be negative or zero. The written result must cover every subset, not only the subsets that contain a value.
notes: Compare after trimming trailing newlines. The input is tokens in the same order as the method parameters.
